name: Polymarket USD
oneLiner: PUSD is Polymarket's USDC-backed prediction-market account stablecoin on Polygon; minted when users deposit USDC and redeemable through the Polymarket app.
collateral: USDC and bridged USDC.e backing on Polygon used for Polymarket prediction-market account balances
pegMechanism: Minted when users deposit supported USDC into Polymarket rails and redeemable back to USDC through the Polymarket application flow

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: PUSD is a Polygon UUPS-proxy ERC-20 minted 1:1 via the CollateralOnramp wrap() function. Both PUSD token and the immutable Onramp are owned by a custom Timelock (0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c, minDelay=43200s/12h). PUSD does not create base USDC supply; inherits Circle mint authority.

controls.label: Polymarket CollateralOnramp (immutable, wrap-only mint path)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: onramp owner() = 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c (Timelock, 12h). EIP-1967 proxy slots both 0x0 — immutable. Onramp has pause admin (ABI includes pause/unpause) — modulesOrGuardsStatus=present for the pause surface. Cannot create base USDC.

controls.label: PUSD token (UUPS proxy, owner=Timelock)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x6bbcef9f7ef3b6c592c99e0f206a0de94ad0925f (UUPS proxy). Proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS upgrade controlled by owner). owner() = 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c (same Timelock, 12h). No separate proxy admin contract — upgrade gated by Timelock.

review.evidence: At Polygon block 88325248: PUSD is a UUPS proxy (impl=0x6bbcef9f...) and Onramp is immutable. Both are owned by custom Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c. minDelay() = 43200s (12h, confirmed via selector 0xc63c4e9b). Prior blocker 'confirm admin/owner address' is resolved: Timelock is the sole admin of both token and onramp.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: PUSD is an application deposit receipt backed by supported USDC balances and redeemed through Polymarket rails.
